id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

name.description:
The name of the @{Sensor} that will be created using this @{MasterSensor}.
Typically, the sensor name is unique and matches the id.
When ingesting MasterSensor data, the name may not always be defined for some users.
Therefore, the `sensorId` field should be relied upon for uniqueness.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

sensorId.description: The unique id of the @{Sensor} which will be created using this @{MasterSensor}.

facility.description: The facility to which this @{MasterSensor} belongs to. Assumes that facilities are creating @{MasterSensor} for that facility.

sensorDescription.description: The description of the @{Sensor} which will be created using this @{MasterSensor}.

exampleValue.description:
This represents an example of the value for the corresponding @{Sensor}.
It serves as a reference for how the sensor's value might appear, such as '12.03'.

unit.description: The unit of the measurements from the @{Sensor}.

convertedSensor.description:
The {@link Sensor} that is created using this {@link MasterSensor}.
This field will be populated when actual @{Sensor}s are created later.

title:
The type stores the core metadata for a sensor, including its ID, description, example value, and unit of measurement.
This metadata serves as a blueprint for creating new sensors.
When actual @{Sensor}s are instantiated, a refernce of those sensors is added to this type.
name: MasterSensor
